# GitHub Discussions guide

[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/AtulFalle/ng-elemental/discussions) is the place for community conversation that does not belong in a bug report or feature request.

## Categories

| Category | Use for |
| --- | --- |
| **General** | Anything NgElemental-related that does not fit another category |
| **Help / Q&A** | Questions about CLI usage, component APIs, setup, theming, or Nx integration |
| **Ideas** | Open-ended suggestions for new components, CLI features, MCP improvements, or workflow ideas before they become formal issues |
| **MCP** | Questions and discussion about using NgElemental through AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude, VS Code Copilot, Codex) |
| **Show & Tell** | Share what you have built with NgElemental — projects, design systems, customizations |

## When to open an issue instead

- You found a definite bug → [bug report](https://github.com/AtulFalle/ng-elemental/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
- You have a concrete feature request with a clear use case → [feature request](https://github.com/AtulFalle/ng-elemental/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)
- You found an accessibility problem → [accessibility issue](https://github.com/AtulFalle/ng-elemental/issues/new?template=accessibility.yml)
- CLI or MCP bug → [CLI issue](https://github.com/AtulFalle/ng-elemental/issues/new?template=cli.yml) / [MCP issue](https://github.com/AtulFalle/ng-elemental/issues/new?template=mcp.yml)

## Tips

- Search existing discussions before opening a new one.
- Include your Angular and CLI versions when asking about compatibility.
- For MCP questions, include your client (Cursor / Claude / VS Code) and any relevant config.
